title: I just released my first idle incremental, a Roblox Game where you breed chickens
author: ZFCornepoil
selftext:
Hello everyone ! I just released my first Roblox game and since it's an idle incremental, I'd love feedback from you guys.

It is a game where you place chickens in coops, they produce resources, and you cross breeds in incubators to discover all the breeds, each with 3 stats you can breed up to 10/10/10. (Maybe it will ring a bell in your head)

You will find several layers of progression : crossing breeds, breeding the same breed to improve stats, mastering breeds for permanent bonuses, and 10 prestige tiers that unlock rarer breeds and more incubators, but also machines to create eggs differently and more to come.  
We have offline production, automations that will help you a lot and mastery on the different chickens.

Bonus ! I already created a Halloween event until November 5th, with candy to collect and 3 limited chickens :)

I need opinions on multiple points:

1. Do the few first prestiges come too early, too late, or about right ?
2. Does breeding for better stats feel rewarding ?
3. Is there a moment where it feels confusing ?
4. If you played more than 10 minutes, does the progression feel good and rewarding?

If you want to try it : [https://www.roblox.com/games/115257897405357/Hatch-A-Chicken](https://www.roblox.com/games/115257897405357/Hatch-A-Chicken)

(Free code: CHICKEN)

Any honest feedback is welcome, even harsh ! Thank you :)

(AI disclosure : This game was made with the help of AI on assets and code)
